MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Online Form 2025 – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the post of Group 4 Stenographer. This recruitment has been issued for 861 posts. Online applying process for MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Recruitment 2025 will start from 04 February 2025 & the candidates can apply till18 February 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 February 2025
  • Last Date : 18 February 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 18 February 2025
  • Exam Date : 30 March 2025
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Category : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 250/-
  • EWS / PH (Divyang) : Rs. 250/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
